title: Analysis code for sex disparity and the sex adjustment in creatinine-based chronic kidney disease staging, with conditional mutual information estimator diagnostics
description:
Analysis code accompanying three manuscripts on biological sex in creatinine-based chronic kidney disease staging.

Reproduces every reported figure: the unmitigated and mitigated model results of the first study, including calibration of the advanced-stage risk and stability across eighty independent partitions; the equation-level counterfactual, conditional randomisation test and partial information decomposition of the second; and the negative-control estimator diagnostic of the third, with its sample-size and neighbourhood-size sweep, specificity evaluation and non-monotone dependence check.

Patient data are not included. The two preparation scripts rebuild the analytic files from the source workbooks.
